<includeonly><div class="pdx-version" style="float:right; margin:0 0 0.5em 0.5em; padding:0.2em 0.6em; border:1px solid #a2a9b1; background:#f8f9fa; font-size:90%;">{{#if:{{{2|}}}|{{{2}}}|Version}}&nbsp;'''{{{1|?}}}'''</div></includeonly><noinclude>
== Purpose ==
Marks which game or mod version a generated page was produced from. Every
'''pdxparse''' output file begins with this template, filled in from the
<code>version:</code> field in <code>settings.yml</code>.

== Usage ==
<pre>
{{Version|1.16}}
{{Version|3.4.1|Mod version}}
</pre>

=== Parameters ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| <code>1</code> || yes || The version string.
|-
| <code>2</code> || no || Label shown before the version. Defaults to <code>Version</code>. Useful on mod wikis, where the meaningful number is the mod's, not the base game's.
|}
[[Category:Templates]]
[[Category:Pdxparse templates]]
</noinclude>
